title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Financial Command Center. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Financial Command Center
options.lineage: Modern trading desk · Swiss-modern precision · Dark-first command surfaces
options.body: The interface treats numbers as architecture. Dark matte command surfaces with crisp white data, modern grotesk headings, and precise color signals (green for income, coral-red for expense, amber for pending). The dashboard is a data-first command view where every number earns its pixel. The left rail is a disciplined navigation column with icon+label groupings. Forms are high-contrast, touch-first, single-column — designed for standing at a counter. Dark mode native, light as alternate.

options.label: Cassette Futurism
options.lineage: 1970s audio deck fascia · Brushed carbon, amber LED status, chrome-edge data
options.body: FUSED ALTERNATE. Every function gets its own labeled switch. Dark brushed carbon surfaces replace aluminum, amber LED ladders become status indicators for reconciliation and sync progress. Chrome-edge data cards house key metrics. The tactile switch discipline maps to the accounting need for clear, confident controls — every action is deliberate. Segmented controls replace radio buttons, VU-meter sparklines replace bar charts. The discipline: nothing unlabeled, no hidden state.
